simplifications_vs_elmer: wall internal joints (z=-20 m and z=-25 m) are still welded into one bonded continuum, instead of Elmer's compliant Mortar BC springs there (see module docstring); this is a smaller, still-documented simplification

the wall/foundation interface is now modelled with discrete DIS_T springs (3412 node pairs) using the same per-axis N/m^3 stiffness as Elmer's Mortar BC, lumped onto each pair's tributary area -- it is no longer welded bonded
the foundation/bedrock interface remains welded bonded, matching Elmer (which also bonds this interface)

bedrock's 4 slanted side boundaries are approximated as fully fixed (DDL_IMPO) instead of Elmer's local-frame normal-only roller springs; only the axis-aligned bottom keeps a true RIGI_PARASOL roller spring

15540 severely sliver bedrock tetrahedra (shape quality > 50, inherited from Elmer's own graded_bedrock.py mesh grading in the far-field domain-truncation region) were dropped: Code_Aster's MECA_STATIQUE solved 'successfully' on the full mesh but silently produced an all-NaN displacement field with them present (see BEDROCK_SLIVER_QUALITY_THRESHOLD's docstring)

a further 1815 bedrock tetrahedra were dropped because they were the sole/near-sole (< 3) support of a free (non-boundary, non-concrete) node: such nodes caused a MUMPS 'pivot nul ou presque nul' (FACTOR_11) solve failure even after the sliver-quality cleanup above (see MIN_FREE_NODE_SUPPORT's docstring)
